name: Flume
author: Mark Steere (January 2010) / AGP port
description: Flume (Mark Steere, 2010) is played on the intersections of a Go board whose outermost ring is filled with permanent green stones. Red and Blue take turns adding a stone to any empty point - but a stone that touches 3 or 4 neighbours (green ring included) forces you to place again immediately, so a single turn can cascade into a run of points. The board fills completely and the larger army wins; the playable side is odd, so a draw is arithmetically impossible. Red may not open on the centre point, and Blue gets the pie rule.
